# Excerpt of adb shell dumpsys power, Android 16 emulator (sdk_gphone64_x86_64), after the power key: screen off
POWER MANAGER (dumpsys power)

Power Manager State:
  Settings power_manager_constants:
    no_cached_wake_locks=true
  mDirty=0x0
  mWakefulness=Asleep
  mWakefulnessChanging=false
  mIsPowered=false
  mPlugType=0
  mBatteryLevel=100
  mDreamsBatteryLevelDrain=0
